Description: Hardcoded absolute path to local git workspace in config/code/scripts
Author: casonk
Message:
feat: add web UI, mTLS stack, system-scope job management, and example manifests

Web UI (web/app.py):
- Flask app for browsing, enabling, and disabling jobs across all example manifests
- Served behind Caddy with mTLS over WireGuard
- User-scope jobs via systemctl --user; system-scope jobs via sudo -n wrapper
- Self-unit detection via /proc/self/cgroup prevents toggle-all from disabling the running server
- Read-only systemctl queries run without sudo; only writes use sudo -n

System-scope elevation (config/sudoers/, config/scripts/):
- sudoers drop-in granting NOPASSWD for the specific commands needed
- clockwork-system-install wrapper sets PYTHONPATH for root (editable pip install not visible otherwise)

mTLS provisioning (scripts/):
- setup-mtls.sh: generates CA, server cert, client cert, iOS mobileconfig
- setup_caddy.py: installs Caddyfile, certs, SELinux contexts, restarts Caddy,
  enables user lingering, and enables clockwork-web.service
- export_clockwork_mtls_profile.py: per-device mobileconfig export

CLI improvements (src/clockwork/):
- render.py: clean PermissionError on system-scope writes without root
- cli.py: handle_install catches PermissionError and exits with rc=1

Examples: add archility, clockwork, doseido, dyno-lab, tachometer, zillow-public-data;
move traction-control/archility-* to examples/archility/

Docs: update README, AGENTS, LESSONSLEARNED with web UI, mTLS, and sudo patterns

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
